label: Preseason Week 3
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
headline: Preseason Week 3 was finales, roster noise, and sticky status stories through Thursday, then X went dark Friday–Saturday (client-not-enrolled) so those three nights are blank. Cleveland owned the room again: Watson named the Week 1 starter, Alex Wright lost to Achilles. San Francisco stayed loud on Kittle off PUP and the York news; Seattle’s sale, New England’s Boutte trade, and LaPorta back in Detroit were the other threads that stuck. Quiet rooms stayed quiet. Vibe only.

items.title: Bills Name Alec Anderson Starting Left Guard for 2026

items.title: Bears Exploring Trade Options for Gervon Dexter After Early Practice Exit
items.one_line: Gervon Dexter, the 24-year-old defensive tackle with 13.5 career sacks, left practice early Tuesday, handing first-team reps to rookie Jordan van den Berg and fueling trade buzz.

items.title: Bears Activate Elliott and Hicks, Trim Roster Ahead of Deadline

items.title: Bears' Wright and Burden Return to Practice After Injury Scares
items.one_line: Darnell Wright (elbow) and Luther Burden (groin) were back at Halas Hall without restrictions.

items.title: ESPN Analyst Flags Bengals Offensive Line as Key Concern Ahead of 2026
items.one_line: Louis Riddick flagged Cincinnati's OL; fans pushed back citing late-2025 grades and all five starters returning.

items.title: Bengals Release Veteran Lineman Cody Ford Ahead of Roster Cuts
items.one_line: Cody Ford's time with the Bengals came to an end just days before final cuts, after a tough training camp where he shuffled between positions.

items.title: C.J. Uzomah Retires as Cincinnati Bengal After 10 NFL Seasons
items.one_line: C.J. Uzomah returned to Cincinnati, the city that drafted him, to hang up his cleats where it all began—surrounded by family and the stripes he loves.

items.title: Browns Lose Alex Wright to Season-Ending Achilles Injury, Sign Derek Barnett

items.title: Browns QB Drama Peaks as Watson Booed, Sanders Shines in Preseason Loss

items.title: Browns Bench Sanders and Watson for Preseason Finale QB Evaluations
items.one_line: Cleveland Browns fans expected to see Shedeur Sanders under the lights Thursday, but coach Todd Monken shut that down to spotlight the backups instead.

items.title: Navajo Rookie Shiyazh Pete Delivers Stirring Cowboys Locker Room Speech
